summary.content:
Today's selection covers 97 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 55 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Leon Radvinsky, 43, Dies; Built the Adult-Entertainment Giant OnlyFans
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Phishers Pose as Palo Alto Networks' Recruiters for Months in Job Scam
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, Dark Reading, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 57 articles published in the last 24 hours
